taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-11 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 82.6 | 5.04 | 5.04
2 | 162.4 | 1.62 | 6.66
3 | 121.3 | 2.57 | 9.23
4 | 152.0 | 0.91 | 10.14
5 | 105.9 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as KHK-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-11
Curve type: KHK
Aquifer depth: 10.14 m to greater depth (Layer 5, ρ = 105.9 Ω·m)
Recommendation: Target the basal layer below 10.14 m as the primary aquifer zone, since its moderate-to-low resistivity and significant thickness suggest a saturated, permeable formation; proceed with drilling to at least 15–20 m to confirm yield and layer continuity before finalizing casing depth.
